head: Pixel Watch LTE not activating on Verizon, some owners report
dek: Owners of Pixel Watch 5 and older models say LTE won't activate on Verizon, so the watch works only near the paired phone. Android Authority collected the reports; one Pixel Watch 4 owner had the same problem a year ago.
details: One Verizon store swapped a Pixel Watch 5 for another that failed the same way, and Verizon mailed one customer a Pixel Watch 3 as a test, which also failed. One commenter got it fixed after a call of more than four hours that reached a network engineer. Another activated LTE through Google Fi. Verizon and Google hadn't commented when the article went up.
where: US, Verizon, LTE Pixel Watch models (reports for Pixel Watch 3, 4 and 5)
means: If your LTE Pixel Watch is on Verizon, calls, texts, Google Wallet and Gemini may only work while your phone is close by.
todo: If activation fails, ask Verizon support to escalate it to a network engineer, as one owner did; Google Fi activated the watch for another owner.
thumb_words: PIXEL WATCH LTE FAILS ON VERIZON
